summary: Equinor ASA filed a routine Form 6-K press release detailing daily open-market purchases under its employee share-programme buy-back announced February 4, 2026, covering February 13, 2026 to January 15, 2027. On September 15, 2026 the company bought 379,361 own shares on Oslo Børs at a weighted average of NOK 419.1253, totaling NOK 158,999,793. Programme aggregate is NOK 1,971,000,000 for up to 19,600,000 shares; cumulative buy-backs reached 3,778,442 shares. Treasury holdings now equal 19,798,825 shares, or 0.83% of share capital. No premium, advisor or board recommendation disclosed.
